findings.finding: Windows adjustment is confined to lstat-versus-fstat opening comparison. It ignores only incompatible cross-API ctime and filename-derived execute bits. Device, inode, all remaining mode bits, size, mtime and exposed birthtime must agree; asymmetric birthtime availability rejects.

The original full _signature remains unchanged and is still used for fstat-before/fstat-after and lstat-before/lstat-after checks. Same-API ctime and mode mutations therefore remain rejection conditions. POSIX opening comparison retains the complete original signature.

Safe-path traversal/reparse rejection, regular-file checks, byte limits, exact read length, decoding, raw SHA-256 comparison, schema/ID/wave/status/text/ownership admission, and strict-versus-progress behavior remain unchanged. No blanket exception or platform skip was added.

A51 canonicalizes only the private temporary fixture parent. This aligns injected descendant paths with the checker-resolved root, including /var aliases. Root-leaf symlink rejection and the original symlink/reparse assertions are unchanged.

The new reader tests exercise actual bounded file reads with synthetic metadata. They distinguish stable Windows representations from identity/type/permission/size/mtime/birthtime changes and retain expected rejection phases for same-API mutations. Linux/Darwin branches are covered separately.
